pages.text: Want to experience life as another gender? The Gender Ward welcomes you~$(br2)All medicines here are used by $(thing)right-clicking the target$(). A word of caution: there's a $(#FF69B4)20%$() chance of a rare gender anomaly!
$(item)Female Potion$() — one sip and you become a girl! (anomalies notwithstanding)
$(item)Male Potion$() — one sip and you become a boy! (success not fully guaranteed)
$(item)Estrogen$() / $(item)Testosterone$() — the two pillars of hormone replacement therapy, gently steering your endocrine direction.

$(item)Spironolactone$() (anti-androgen) and $(item)Aromatase$() — suppress or convert male hormones; key supports of hormone therapy.$(br2)Always follow your doctor's advice (there is no doctor, meow).
